data.reasoning: The first report failed entirely due to API errors and provides no verdict signal. The second report successfully reviewed all three files in the repository (.SRCINFO, .gitignore, PKGBUILD) and correctly identified the package as a standard, safe AUR binary package. The PKGBUILD downloads a pinned source from the official GitHub releases with a valid SHA256 checksum, and the package() function performs standard installation steps without executing arbitrary code or fetching from untrusted sources.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is purely due to a tool error (HTTP 400) in the first model, which caused it to fail to evaluate any files. The second model successfully evaluated the package and found it safe.
coverage_issues: qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 failed to audit any files due to LLM API request failures (HTTP 400).
learnings: Ensure graceful handling or retry logic for LLM API errors (HTTP 400) to prevent complete audit failures when a model's API call fails.
